youtube.title: Why Car Tires Have Grooves 🌧️ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Racing slick tires have no tread and grip best on dry tracks, because more rubber touches the road. Road tires have grooves because on wet roads a thin film of water can lift a smooth tire off the surface, called aquaplaning. The grooves act as channels that pump water out from under the rubber so it can keep gripping.
